commercialProperty.name: Storefront or single tenant
commercialProperty.summary: Focused coverage for one business, suite or standalone location.
commercialProperty.scope: One primary interior and exterior, usually under 5,000 sq ft, about 45 to 60 minutes on site. Best for retail, restaurant, medical or small office.

commercialProperty.name: Small commercial
commercialProperty.summary: Comprehensive coverage for a straightforward single-building asset.
commercialProperty.scope: One building with one to five key spaces, often up to 15,000 to 20,000 sq ft, about 1 to 1.5 hours on site. Small office, mixed use, retail strip or warehouse.

commercialProperty.name: Mid-size commercial
commercialProperty.summary: Expanded coverage for larger or multi-tenant commercial assets.
commercialProperty.scope: Multiple tenants or distinct areas, often 15,000 to 50,000 sq ft, up to about 2 hours on site. Shopping center, office, industrial or multi-tenant retail.

commercialProperty.name: Large or multi-building
commercialProperty.summary: Extended coverage for substantial or complex commercial properties.
commercialProperty.scope: 50,000+ sq ft or multiple buildings, numerous interiors and amenities, often 3+ hours of coverage. Campuses, large centers, industrial complexes or multifamily.
